en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.5759 - Al-Nadr ibn Suwayd narrated from Yahya Al-Halabi, from Ayyub ibn Atiyyah Al-Hadhdha', who said:

I heard Abu Abdullah (as) narrated that the Prophet of Allah (swt) (peace and blessings be upon him and his family) used to say:
"I have a greater claim over every believer than his own self. Whoever leaves behind wealth, it is for his heirs, and whoever leaves behind debt or dependents in need, then it is upon me and my responsibility."
